name: deitax-fms-a
description: Comprehensive petrol station operational management platform featuring live tank and pump monitoring, multi-role POS, 3-way shift reconciliation, eTIMS tax compliance, and audit tracking.

scripts.desktop:build: npm run db:validate && npm run build
scripts.test:atg-tank-monitoring: esbuild tests/atg-tank-monitoring.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/atg-tank-monitoring-test.mjs && node build/atg-tank-monitoring-test.mjs && esbuild tests/atg-concurrency.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/atg-concurrency-test.mjs && node build/atg-concurrency-test.mjs
scripts.test:reconciliation: esbuild tests/reconciliation.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/reconciliation-test.mjs && node build/reconciliation-test.mjs && esbuild tests/reconciliation-concurrency.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/reconciliation-concurrency-test.mjs && node build/reconciliation-concurrency-test.mjs && esbuild tests/reconciliation-restart.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/reconciliation-restart-test.mjs && node build/reconciliation-restart-test.mjs && esbuild tests/reconciliation-api.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/reconciliation-api-test.mjs && node build/reconciliation-api-test.mjs
scripts.test:alerts: esbuild tests/alerts.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/alerts-test.mjs && node build/alerts-test.mjs && esbuild tests/alerts-api.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/alerts-api-test.mjs && node build/alerts-api-test.mjs && esbuild tests/alert-concurrency.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/alert-concurrency-test.mjs && node build/alert-concurrency-test.mjs
scripts.test:offline-recovery: esbuild tests/offline-recovery.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/offline-recovery-test.mjs && node build/offline-recovery-test.mjs && esbuild tests/recovery-api.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=build/recovery-api-test.mjs && node build/recovery-api-test.mjs
scripts.desktop:dist: node scripts/clean-desktop-output.mjs && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis
